newsitem.title: LATVIA: Latvian shares mixed, traders hope for pick up.
newsitem.headline: Latvian shares mixed, traders hope for pick up.

text.p: Latvian share traders said they saw some signs of stabilisation in the market on Tuesday after several sessions of low volumes and slipping share prices.
They said more activity may come after a spate of shareholder meetings in early May comes to an end.
Total turnover was 88,000 lats versus 171,000 lats and the Rietumu Bank index rose 0.74 percent to 180.3.
"There are slight signs of price stabilisation but I would not expect more activity until mid-May," said Uldis Bulavs, a dealer with Trasta Bank.
Daugavpils Chain was the most traded stock on volume of 39,000 lats as it slipped to 2.31 lats from 2.35.
Leading bank Unibanka advanced 10 santimes to 3.60 lats on 19,700 lats.
Volumes were below 1,000 lats on the secondary list, apart from Kaija fish cannery, Rigas Raugs and Valmiera Glassfibre.

Kaija slipped one santime to 2.25 on trade of 7,000 lats. The cannery today holds its annual shareholders' meeting and is expected to announce its audited 1996 figures. Its first quarter data are also expected later today or on Wednesday.
Rigas Raugs yeast factory saw 3,800 lats of shares change hands as it slipped one santime to 3.77 lats while Valmiera remained stable at 1.50 lats on trade of 3,500 lats.
